title: Surface Area of Prisms and Cylinders
introduction: Develop mathematical understanding through surface area of prisms and cylinders.
definition: Surface area is the total area of the outside surfaces. A right prism has two matching bases and lateral area equal to the perimeter of the base multiplied by its length. A closed right cylinder has two circles and a curved surface that unfolds into a rectangle.
